name: Continiuum
tagline: Watches your servers, phones you on a critical error, and explains the likely root cause and fix.
problem: When systems fail, logs explode and it takes too long to understand what broke.
solution: A dashboard monitors containers in real time, calls developers by phone on critical errors, and generates a root-cause summary and suggested fixes.
demo_moment: Team-described: break a service and get a phone call with an explanation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best .Tech Domain Name” among 82 submissions.
Explains incidents instead of only alerting.

lessons: A phone call during the demo makes an alerting tool tangible.
